transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we dive in, let's make sure we're aligned on today's goal. As you all know, the courtyard will host the live filmmaker Q&A after the evening screening, and I need to approve the final production and release plan before we open the courtyard to guests. Per our standard process, I'll need both the sound and rights leads to give their status reports before I can sign off. So let's hear where things stand — sound first, then rights, and then we'll work through any open items together.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag something important for my sound status report. I completed an RF survey of the courtyard after soundcheck and found that wireless microphones are unreliable there due to interference from the neighboring broadcast compound. The Q&A must use exactly four wired microphones instead. I should also note that the survey report is still awaiting upload to the production folder — I'll get that uploaded as soon as we wrap here.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: For my rights status report, I need to flag something critical that hasn't made it into the event file yet. I confirmed with the filmmaker's representative after the rights packet was circulated, and the appearance release has specific constraints: it permits an audio-only recording, it prohibits public video release, and the podcast episode can only be released on September 15, 2026. This confirmation arrived after the rights packet went out, so it's not reflected in what anyone has seen so far. Given that the Q&A is being recorded for the podcast feed, these release restrictions directly affect the production and release plan Mara needs to approve.
transcript.speaker: A3
